newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 564c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 5c to 564c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose by 5.0 cents to 569 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Melbourne on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were dearer, with the 19/23 micron indicators 0.5 percent dearer and 20/21m 1.0 percent dearer.
The 24/25m categories were 1.5 percent dearer, 25m was up to 1.5 percent dearer and 26m 2.5 percent dearer, WI said.
In crossbreds, 27m was 1.0 percent dearer and 28/31m slightly dearer. The 29m category was unchanged while 30m was 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were 1.0 percent dearer, locks 1.0 percent cheaper and crutchings generally unchanged.
WI said there was good general competition with China, Japan and Western Europe active.
Of 20,035 bales offered in both centres, 8.3 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 38,300 bales to be offered.
